scope: Runtime Vulkan diagnostic, not an emulator correctness or gameplay fix
reason: The native signed-image-atomic correction now generates 63/63 validator-accepted modules including both formerly rejected shaders, yet GoW still loses RADV at 22.191s. Runtime Vulkan core and synchronization validation were not enabled. Structural SPIR-V validation does not establish correct live API arguments, resource state or synchronization.
protection: Verify clean restored PR94 and protected gameplay/PR91/PR94/current candidate hashes. Add a separate detached worktree at the exact tested source and copy the identical ELF. Never switch, reset, patch or rebuild the original worktree. Reuse original private-profile copy, bounded 118+2-second observer, conditional 8GiB Ollama policy and existing shared locks. No automatic input or service/network restarts.
profile_changes: Private copied profile only: dump_shaders=true, vkvalidation_enabled=true, vkvalidation_core_enabled=true, vkvalidation_sync_enabled=true, vkvalidation_gpu_enabled=false. Dumping was already enabled in the preceding run. Require shader overrides, null GPU and pipeline caching to remain off. Verify no other settings change.
layer_preflight: Enumerate installed validation layer and its VK_EXT_layer_settings support, then create/destroy an instance with the requested layer. No VkDevice or queue is created by this preflight. Refuse game launch if layer cannot load.
optional_local_tool: If no loadable system layer, read existing local APT metadata for exactly Debian trixie vulkan-validationlayers 1.4.309.0-1 amd64 and its expected package path, size and SHA256. Download over HTTPS, verify size/hash, and extract only the regular layer library and manifest inside this unique experiment directory. No apt update/install, sudo, package scripts, system libraries or driver changes. VK_LAYER_PATH is set only for child processes. Missing exact package metadata or failed load probe means no game launch. Checksum comes from the host APT index; no globally hardcoded package checksum is claimed.
early_stop: Watch actual VUID error or SYNC-HAZARD messages. Acquire Linux pidfd only after verifying the announced PID runs the private copied executable and descends from the owned runtime. On an observed error, terminate only that owned process, with forced termination after two seconds if needed; let the existing observer finish cleanup. Never pkill, kill by executable name or terminate unrelated processes. A report may arrive after GPU submission: no guarantee of avoiding a device reset.
outputs: Outer gow-vulkan-validation-*.tar.gz includes layer provenance/load diagnostics, exact private configuration changes, native runtime evidence, first validation error, full validation messages and IDs, and before/after protection checks. Append the shared local trials.jsonl for success or failure. No guest shader contents or user profile contents published to GitHub.
